profile_text.body:
MiniMax is a for-profit AI startup founded in early 2022 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. The company describes itself as a global leader in multi-modal foundation models and AI-native products, with a stated mission of advancing toward Artificial General Intelligence. According to its own site, MiniMax has independently developed multimodal foundation models capable of processing and generating text, audio, image, video, and music, with capabilities the company highlights in code generation, agent tasks, and ultra-long context handling. The site claims a user base of over 200 million.

Building on those foundation models, MiniMax has released a suite of products including MiniMax Code, MiniMax Design, MiniMax Audio, Talkie, and an open platform aimed at enterprises and developers. The site also references an open platform for broader developer access. The company's tracked products include its core MiniMax large language model, categorized as a Chinese foundation model, and Hailuo AI, a video generation product offered under the MiniMax brand, with cross-border data review flagged as advisable for both.

MiniMax is a defendant in a lawsuit filed by Disney Enterprises in the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, styled Disney Enterprises, Inc. v. Minimax. No further details about the claims or status appear in the available data.
